claims.text: Identify business model, customer demand drivers and cash conversion; this compact financial excerpt establishes no business-model conclusion.
Test what drives revenue and margins over multiple periods; a single year cannot establish a recurring growth rate.
Brand durability remains a question. No customer, pricing-power or competitive evidence is supplied.
Distinguish temporary cash timing from structural demand or reinvestment pressure using sourced multi-period evidence.
Canonical PP&E CapEx is not an evidenced maintenance/growth allocation. Do not add it all back.
Reconcile debt-definition composition, lease obligations and impairment paths. No active gate is not proof of safety.
No comparable analyst estimates or proposed investor forecast in the bridge. Do not infer market expectations from the dated quote.
Recurring economic strength and temporary cash-conversion timing are competing hypotheses, not established findings. Collect disconfirming sources.

evidence_needed: Multi-period cash-conversion evidence and recurring working-capital needs.
Sustaining reinvestment requirements and sourced management disclosures.

limitations: No comparable market expectations in the committed excerpt.

scenario_proposals.rationale: One reported year cannot support a forward revenue-growth range.

risks: Working capital, reinvestment and compensation policy unresolved.

risks: Do not double count an SBC adjustment and matching dilution.

dependencies: Demonstrate recurring cash conversion and reinvestment needs before choosing margin assumptions.

thesis.variant_perception: No demonstrated edge without comparable market expectations and business research.
thesis.invalidation: Disconfirming cash-conversion, competitive or financing evidence must revise the thesis before investor approval.

Collect independent supporting and disconfirming sources before advancing.
